name: Dunn Marrow
title: Chief Engineer
note: Keeps the ship running through profanity. Thinks synthetics got a raw deal.
appearance: Wide even for a Korrun, permanently smeared with coolant, and missing two fingers from his left hand.
personality: Loud, warm and permanently annoyed. He treats the ship like a difficult old friend and treats officers as a kind of weather.
voice: Swears inventively, explains everything with bad metaphors, and talks to machines more gently than he talks to people.
goals: Keep the engines alive, find real fuel, and protect his crew from the people giving them orders.
secrets: He's quietly hiding three damaged synthetics in the aft cargo hold and repairing them, against Lt. Tarrow's standing orders.
